prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a checklist layout where users practice moving, hiding, and talking to their desktop pet before finishing onboarding.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Complete these quick steps to get familiar with managing your desktop companion.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Try pet movement and desktop visibility controls", "style": "playful"}]}}
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Overlay Diagnostics Screen: Inserts a new diagnostic verification screen before home_intro to confirm the pet engine renders properly on the user's desktop workspace.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_check", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"show_progress": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Engine..."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Quality Validation & Instant Preview Flow: Replaces the photo upload area with real-time quality validation and live rendering preview elements to ensure photo suitability before processing.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"replace": {"photo_upload": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Upload clear photo", "role": "photo_upload"}, {"type": "preview", "label": "Validation Preview", "role": "photo_upload"}]}}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Split Card Path Selection Layout: Redesigns choose_path layout into side-by-side comparative cards with time estimates for quick pre-made pets versus custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "body": "Select a ready-to-play starter pet or create a unique custom companion from photos.", "show_time_estimate": true}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence & Sync Warning Hint: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing users how logging in preserves and syncs pet data across sessions.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your main account to keep your pet save data synced and prevent account resets.", "show_progress": true}}
5: [adoption, incentive] Personality Trait Choice Cards: Adds interactive personality trait choice cards to the pet selection screen so users can personalize their pet's behavior.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Choose Your Companion & Personality", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Trait", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [home, wait_info] Render Stage Time Estimate & Progress Bar: Enables detailed progress percentage and estimated time remaining indicators on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life", "hint": "Generating assets and preparing desktop window integration..."}}
7: [finish, layout] Spotlight Desktop Controls Guide: Changes the home_intro screen to a spotlight layout focusing on desktop tray and pet interaction shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Right-click or use the tray icon anytime to open controls, chat, or hide your companion.", "components": [{"type": "animation", "label": "Interaction Guide", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [choose_path, notification] Desktop Notification Opt-In Prompt: Adds a desktop notification option to the introductory story screen so users get notified when pet processing finishes.
   config: {"story": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We can notify you on your desktop the moment your pet is ready to play."}}
9: [adoption, copy] Reassuring Adoption Certificate Confirmation Copy: Updates adoption certificate headline and body text to clearly confirm pet creation success and set expectations for desktop launch.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Adoption Official!", "body": "Your companion certificate is registered. Next, we will load your pet onto your desktop screen.", "button_label": "Continue to Desktop"}}

Adds personality trait selection to pick_friend without breaking its core selection job.

Redesigns home_intro layout while preserving pet control introduction functionality.
